Nothing to set up. A flow step `run: email` or hooks.yaml `email:` step just works on any hosted app.
Default sender: <app-sub>@mail.benmore.ai with the app's display name. Override the local part or use a custom domain via EMAIL_FROM.
Daily quota: 100 emails/day on free, 2,000/day on paid plans (resets midnight UTC). `benmore email <app>` / the dashboard Email tab show usage.

The daily quota is counted per owner account as well as per app. Each recipient of a send counts against the app and against the account that owns it; the account's allowance is the per-app quota times its live-app allowance: the live apps the owner's plan includes plus the extra live-app slots it bought (5 apps' worth on Pro, 25 on Scale, and one app's worth on free, which includes no live app). An operator-raised per-account app limit counts as before, and an account with more published apps than that keeps each published app's quota. Apps still in development add nothing: an account using each of its published apps up to the per-app quota is never refused by the account allowance, and one sending at full per-app quota from more apps in development than it has live slots is. What an app sent stays on its owner's day after the app is deleted; deleting an app and creating another does not start a new quota (the send is refused with `the account's daily email allowance is used up`). Email status reports `account_quota_used_today` and `account_quota_daily_limit` next to the app's own numbers.
